items.name: BonPhoto Bonaire
items.price: Lights/strobes from $20/day (pro kit prices not listed)
items.note: Says it rents professional photo/video gear, runs photo courses and can send a cameraman with you. Best bet for pro footage if it's still operating.
items.flag: Unverified: site was down Oct 21. Contact first.

items.name: Bonaire Photography Center
items.note: Photo coaching, guided photo dives, limited rental.
items.flag: Unverified: page outdated and down Oct 21.

items.name: VIP Diving
items.price: Olympus TG-5 $55/day (+$10 to keep the SD card)
items.note: Close to the Carib Inn. Compact camera, a modest step up from a GoPro. info@vipdiving.com · +599 701 7701

items.name: Dive Friends Bonaire
items.price: SeaLife Micro 3.0 $36/day · smartphone housing $41/day · 10% off 6+ days
items.note: Also PADI Digital Underwater Photographer course $197.

items.name: Buddy Dive
items.price: No camera rental · PADI UW photo course $200

items.name: Fallback: US rental house or videographer
items.note: For true pro footage (mirrorless/DSLR in a housing with lights), rent a kit from a US underwater-camera rental shop and fly it down, or hire a videographer for a dive or two.

items.name: Carib Inn guest truck
items.note: Gas pickup recommended: shore diving means hauling tanks.

items.name: EV note
items.note: EV charging is scarce and the Carib Inn has none. Only a few Type 2 posts (Chogogo, Isidel area, Cicilia Motors).
